retry_seed: SHA256 of original seed, campaign id and retry number; first exit deliveries preserved
retry_order_type: market sell in existing assumed simulator
availability_assumption: The source hour's market availability holds during the same causal quote TTL; not empirical continuous quotes
insufficient_quote_or_retry_budget: Record unresolved inventory; no invented quote, fill or deadline extension
entry_feasibility: Every fixed entry must still pass ledger cash and inventory constraints; otherwise fail the counterfactual
calibration: No parameter search; engineering replay on already examined inputs, not independent preregistration
acceptance: All archived entries preserved; separate Decimal accounting verifies every account; no planned deadline breaches within the declared replay conditions
